products.title: DIRHAM CLOUD 100ML
products.body_html:
Dirham Cloud is built around a quiet reset, the idea of stepping back to find clarity, then 
moving forward with more energy. Light and airy, it creates a sense of calm that feels 
fresh and renewed.
Like a break in the sky, it opens up space: clear, breezy, and softly luminous. It brings a 
lighter mindset, where everything feels more focused and intentional.
It’s a balance between stillness and motion: calm yet active, simple yet refined. Like a 
breath of air catching you at the right moment, it lifts you and keeps you moving 
forward.

FRAGRANCE NOTES: 
Top: Fig, Pear, Cloudberry
Heart: Lily of the Valley, Coconut, Violet Leaf
Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood

products.title: SAWSAN 100ML
products.body_html:
Some fragrances decorate. Sawsan dissolves into you. It opens with Coconut and Peach, not obvious, but the kind of creamy, sun-warmed sweetness that feels like bare skin after a bath. Effortless. Disarming. Then the heart unfolds and everything slows down. Ylang-Ylang and Tuberose bloom together in voluptuous silence, wrapped in Milk so soft it feels like a whisper against warm fabric. The base is where Sawsan becomes unforgettable, Vanilla and Praline melting into Dry Woods and Musk, leaving a trail that is equal parts innocence and intention. The kind of scent that lingers in memory long after you’ve left the room

 

Notes
Top: Coconut, Peach
Heart: Ylang-Ylang, Tuberose, Milk
Base: Vanilla, Praline, Dry Woods, Musk

products.title: SUDFA 100ML
products.body_html:
Sudfa opens with a single yet confident note of Almond, warm and slightly sweet, like the quiet moment before something extraordinary begins. It is understated and assured, setting the tone for what is to come.

At the heart, Lily of the Valley brings a cool, dewy freshness while Heliotrope wraps around it with its powdery, almost edible softness. The two notes move together like light through dark glass, delicate yet with an undeniable depth that pulls you closer.

Then comes the dry down, and Sudfa reveals its true character. Cappuccino drifts in like steam rising from a freshly poured cup, rich and roasted, deepened by the golden warmth of Amber and the silky sweetness of Vanilla Cream. Sandalwood anchors it all with a smooth, woody closeness that settles into the skin and refuses to leave.

Dark yet tender, complex yet effortless, Sudfa is the fragrance of a quiet confidence that needs no introduction.

Notes
Top: Almond
Heart: Lily of the Valley, Heliotrope
Base: Cappuccino, Amber, Vanila Cream, Sandal Wood
